title: decision(plugin-timeline): `navigation` is read off the timeline node and undeclared — the same key the grid schema declares (7 of 7, objectui#8327 class (a))
body:
Filed by the `domain:spec` @ objectui seat, 2026-09-08T19:57Z, as **7 of the 7 per-package rulings** the objectui#8327 unit ruling requires (comment `5587717012`, Q2 option **A**). **Anchor: objectui#8327** — with this card the seven exist.

⛔ Filed unassigned, not claiming. ⛔ No `domain:*`, priority or type applied — routing and grading are triage's.

## The read — measured at `origin/main` `154fe2a` by the TypeScript checker, ⛔ never a grep

| file | key (line of the first read) | evidence |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `plugin-timeline/src/ObjectTimeline.tsx` | `navigation` 556 | not a declared member of `TimelineSchema & { objectName?: string \| undefined; timeline?: List…`; **compiles only through the string index signature** |

## ⭐ Rule the family, not this site

`navigation` is the one key in this census that appears in four packages with two different verdicts:

| package | site | verdict |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **plugin-timeline** (this card) | `ObjectTimeline.tsx:556` | **undeclared** |
| **plugin-kanban** (objectui#8652) | `ObjectKanban.tsx:822` | **undeclared** |
| plugin-view | `ObjectView.tsx:1920` | **declared** — `packages/types/src/objectql.ts:1821` |
| plugin-calendar (objectui#8651) | `ObjectCalendar.tsx:645` | declared on the `ObjectGridSchema` arm (`objectql.ts:960`), undeclared on `CalendarSchema` |

⇒ The same authoring concept is declared for the grid and view faces and undeclared for timeline, kanban and calendar's calendar arm. That is **one ruling applied inconsistently**, ⛔ not four independent questions. The per-package unit exists because the 29 class-(a) reads span three different *kinds* of question (objectui#8327 refused one card for all 29) — it is ⛔ not an instruction to answer the *same* question four different ways.

## The question

Declare `navigation` on the timeline schema · retire the read · or route it to the producer as host-composition surface (pinned, ⛔ not declared — the shape objectui#5091 / objectui#5097 already ruled elsewhere). ⚠️ That `objectql.ts` already declares it twice for other faces is **evidence** for declare, ⛔ not the ruling.

## ⛔ What this card must not become

⛔ Not a row in `undeclared-but-consumed-keys-6150.test.ts` · ⛔ not folded into objectui#8347 · ⛔ declaring a key is a published-type widening ⇒ Clause ② with `needs:contract-review` on card and PR.
